findings.expected: Manual local hide from a profile badge reaches an honest settled state and produces visible, reversible behavior
findings.actual: The profile badge schedules the action, but hideTweet only hides a nearest tweet cell/article. A profile-header anchor has neither, so the profile remains visible; the pending badge is not cleared when the timer settles and disappears only after navigation, while the local processed record suppresses the useful badge on the next load.
